notes: Used only by intune/Remediate-CECompliance.ps1 (Intune Remediations). When enabled, fixes whose remediation id is listed here are applied automatically as SYSTEM after each audit. High-risk remediations are always skipped. 'suggested' lists low-impact fixes that are reasonable starting points; copy the ones you want into remediationIds. Every change is written to an undo log under %ProgramData%\EngramicBaseline\reports.
